class.name: LandscapeVoxelGenerator4D
class.brief_description: A generator producing noise-based landscape terrain.
class.description: LandscapeVoxelGenerator4D computes a relative height at each point: its Y coordinate plus several octaves of 4D value noise, so the noise displaces the terrain vertically by up to about [member intensity]. The ascending [member material_cutoffs] are heights splitting space into bands, and each band is filled with the corresponding entry of [member materials], from the deepest band up; the last material fills the band above every cutoff, so there is one more material than cutoffs. Bands beyond the materials list, or everywhere while the list is empty, are undefined.

members.member: The scale of the finest octave's noise along the three horizontal axes, in voxels. Coarser octaves double it each step.
The amplitude of the coarsest octave, in voxels of height.
The heights of the boundaries between consecutive bands of [member materials], in voxels and ascending order. The noise displaces each boundary vertically from its cutoff height.
The materials of the height bands, from the deepest band up. Should hold one more entry than [member material_cutoffs]; bands without an entry are undefined.
The number of noise layers, each at twice the scale of the previous.
The factor between the amplitudes of consecutive octaves: each finer octave's amplitude is the previous amplitude times this.
The vertical (Y) scale of the finest octave's noise, in voxels. Coarser octaves double it each step.
